cache_structure_after_first_machine.note: 686 B includes entry slots at reported capacity plus key String, Vec and value String capacities; +48 B for the inline HashMap header. Excludes allocator size-class overhead and hash control bytes. Cache persists after all machines are removed.

comparison.interpretation: In the three matched sessions, median RSS growth from 0 to 1,000 machines was similar with and without caching; after removal RSS remained near the 1,000-machine state. The cache itself is <1 KiB for this block. These measurements do not isolate causality: the +0.83 MiB normalized growth delta neither establishes nor rules out cache attribution of the prior +8.04 MiB whole-process/build delta. No further RSS matrix was run. No memory-leak or corruption cause is established.
